introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent, feet hip-width apart. Place your arms at your sides, palms pressing gently into the mat.

Inhale deeply, press through your feet to lift your hips off the floor. Let your chest open and gently draw it toward your chin, creating a natural arch in your back. Keep your shoulders grounded and your gaze upward. 

Hold the pose for a few breaths. With each inhale, lengthen through your spine; with each exhale, relax into the stretch.
name: BRIDGE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominal muscles.
Inhale to lengthen through your spine. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
Lift your one leg up if it's too easy for you.
This is a great exercise to target your legs, core and gluteus.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees up at a 90 degree angle. 

Extend your arms to the sides and put your palms down on the ground. 

Twist your legs to the left while keeping your upper body in place and your knees and feet together. 

Hold it for one second, then return and twist to the other side. Repeat the exercise.
name: BENT LEG TWIST

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please do it slowly to get better results.
Please make sure your knees and feet are together.
Please tighten your abs during the entire exercise.
Please keep your knees at a 90 degree angle.
Please don\'t rotate your legs to the point where your opposite arm can no longer stay on the floor.
Exhale as you twist your knees to one side.
Inhale as you bring your knees back to center.
This exercise targets your core muscles.

introduce: Sit on the floor, lift your legs up at a 45 degree angle, and lean your upper body back at a 45 degree angle. Stretch your arms forward. Hold this position.\n\nDon't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.
name: V-HOLD

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Try to keep your legs as straight as you can.
Please don\'t arch your back.
Breathe regularly.
To make it easier, lower your feet on the floor.
This exercise targets the rectus abdominis and obliques.
This exercise enhances core strength.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Put your left hand on your right knee and your right hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest. Exhale and twist your upper body to the right. 

Hold this position, allowing your spine to lengthen with each inhale and deepen the twist with each exhale.
name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your left arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Put your right hand on your left knee and your left hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest. Exhale and twist your upper body to the left. 

Hold this position, allowing your spine to lengthen with each inhale and deepen the twist with each exhale.
name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your right arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Sit on the floor with legs extended. Put your hands directly under your shoulders with your fingers pointing toward your hips. 

Lift your hips off the floor. Keep your body straight. Hold this position.

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.
name: REVERSE PLANK

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Please tighten your core.
Breathe naturally.
Don't sink your hips.
Please put your hands directly under your shoulders.
This exercise helps burn your back fat, tighten your core and improve your posture.

introduce: Lie flat on your back with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms up. \n\nInhale slowly through your nose, your spine gently lengthening and your body becoming light. Exhale fully, allowing your shoulders, hips, and entire body to melt into the mat, and consciously relax any areas of tightness or tension throughout your body.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to release tension of your body.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wide apart. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and open your chest. Exhale slowly to hinge at your hips and fold your torso forward from your hips, keeping your back long. Place your hands on the floor.

Hold the position with deep, steady breaths. With each exhale, relax and allow your body to sink deeper.
name: WIDE LEGGED FORWARD FOLD

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back flat.
Tighten your abs.
Please squeeze your quadriceps and inner thighs.
You can slightly bend your knees if you feel it’s too hard.
Too hard? You can press your fingertips on a block or something similar.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to soften into the stretch.
This position stretches your inner thighs and hamstrings.
This position relieves tension in your lower back.

introduce: Step your left foot forward into a wide stance. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to bend your upper body over your front leg and place your hands on the ground.\n\nKeep both legs straight and draw your chest closer to your left thigh. Hold the position, breathing slowly and deeply.
name: DOWNWARD DOG LEFT

tips.text: Please keep your legs straight.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw your torso closer to your thigh.
Please try to press your back heel on the ground for a deep stretch.
This position stretches your hamstrings and calves.

introduce: Step your right foot forward into a wide stance. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to bend your upper body over your front leg and place your hands on the ground.\n\nKeep both legs straight and draw your chest closer to your right thigh. Hold the position, breathing slowly and deeply.
name: DOWNWARD DOG RIGHT

tips.text: Please keep your legs straight.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw your torso closer to your thigh.
Please try to press your back heel on the ground for a deep stretch.
This position stretches your hamstrings and calves.

introduce:
Sit on the floor with knees bent. Hold your shins and draw your knees toward your chest.

Inhale to roll back, keeping your spine rounded. Exhale as you roll forward toward your knees.

Repeat the pose with a steady breathing rhythm.
name: SPINAL ROLLING

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your spine rounded.
Engage your core to keep balance.
Don\'t roll back too far on your neck.
Keep the movement controlled.
Inhale to roll back. Exhale to roll forward.
This exercise can loosen up your spine and relieve your back pain.

introduce:
Sit cross-legged and rest your hands on your knees. 

Inhale, lift your gaze and expand your chest. Exhale, round your back, drawing the chin toward the chest.

Repeat the exercise with regular breathing.
name: SEATED CAT COW

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
This exercise stretches your chest, back, abdomen and spine.
This exercise helps reduce the tension in your neck, back, and shoulder.
Inhale when you drive your chest out, and exhale when you round your back.

introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your left leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your right leg forward. Put your left hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the left. Bend your right elbow and hook it on the outside of your left knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your left shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.
name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your right leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your left leg forward. Put your right hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the right. Bend your left elbow and hook it on the outside of your right knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your right shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.
name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

introduce:
Lay prone with your hands under your shoulders and the tops of your feet on the floor. 

Inhale as you press through your hands firmly into the floor. Straighten your arms and lift your chest. Slightly lift your thighs off the ground. Gaze forward or slightly upward.

Hold the position with deep and steady breath. Inhale to expand your chest and lengthen your spine, exhale to soften your shoulders, relax your neck, and keep your arms and core stable.
name: UPWARD FACING DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Rotate your shoulders back and down.
Keep your legs engaged, don\'t slouch them on the floor.
Keep your neck natural, don\'t strain your neck.
This exercise stretches your chest, abdomen, and spine.
This exercise can firm your buttocks and thighs.
Inhale to lift your chest. Exhale to soften your shoulders.

introduce:
Stand with your legs together. Inhale to lift your arms overhead. Exhale, bend your knees and sink your hips back as if sitting on a chair. 

Press your palms together in a prayer position at your chest. On an exhale, twist your torso to the left, hooking your right elbow to the outside of your left knee. 

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist and release tension in your torso.
name: REVOLVED CHAIR POSE LEFT

tips.text: Don’t let your knees go over your toes.
Keep your weight in your heels.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax and deepen the twist.
This exercise stretches your lower back and spine.
This exercise tones your lower body and improves your balance.

introduce:
Stand with your legs together. Inhale to lift your arms overhead. Exhale, bend your knees and sink your hips back as if sitting on a chair. 

Press your palms together in a prayer position at your chest. On an exhale, twist your torso to the right, hooking your left elbow to the outside of your right knee. 

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist and release tension in your torso.
name: REVOLVED CHAIR POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Don't let your knees go over your toes
Keep your weight in your heels.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax and deepen the twist.
This exercise stretches your lower back and spine.
This exercise tones your lower body and improves your balance.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned outward. 

Inhale, bring your hands together into a prayer position at your chest. Exhale, bend your knees and lower your hips as much as possible. Press your elbows against your inner knees to open up your hips. 

Keep your heels on the floor; if needed, place a rolled-up towel under them.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
name: GARLAND POSE

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your groins, lower back, and hips.
This exercise strengthens and stretches your ankles.

introduce: Start on all fours. Exhale as you lift your hips into an inverted ‘V’ shape, and lengthen your spine.\n\nAlternately lift and lower your heels with steady breath.
name: WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Keep a steady and even breathing rhythm without holding your breath.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach, forearms on the floor, elbows under your shoulders, legs extended with the tops of your feet pressing down.

Inhale, press into your palms and forearms, raise your upper body, open your chest, and extend your neck forward and up to open through your shoulders.

Hold the position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to soften your torso into the mat.
name: SPHINX POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
This exercise stretches your chest, shoulders, and abdomen.
This exercise strengthens your spine and helps ease your lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to soften your torso.

introduce:
Begin in a low lunge with your left foot forward and your right leg extended behind you. 

Inhale to come up and press your palms together at your chest. Then exhale as you twist your torso to the left, bringing your right elbow to the outside of your left knee or thigh. 

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist further.
name: REVOLVED SIDE ANGLE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Keep your palms at the center of your chest.
Don\'t let your front knee go over your toes.
This exercise stretches your hips and entire leg muscles.
This exercise strengthens your quadriceps and glutes.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Begin in a low lunge with your right foot forward and your left leg extended behind you. 

Inhale to come up and press your palms together at your chest. Then exhale as you twist your torso to the right, bringing your left elbow to the outside of your right knee or thigh. 

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist further.
name: REVOLVED SIDE ANGLE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your front knee facing forward.
Keep your palms at the center of your chest.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
This exercise stretches your hips and entire leg muscles.
This exercise strengthens your quadriceps and glutes.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart. Turn your left foot to the left and your right foot slightly inward.

Inhale to lengthen your spine, and extend your arms out to the sides. Then exhale to hinge forward from your hips, rotate your torso to the left while sweeping your left arm up to the ceiling. Gently turn your head to look up at your left fingertips, keeping your neck comfortable. 

Hold this position, breathing steadily. Inhale to extend your spine, exhale to deepen the twist and relax your shoulders.
name: REVOLVED TRIANGLE POSE LEFT

tips.text: Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist to the left.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your hand on your leg instead of the floor.
This exercise strengthens and stretches your legs.
This exercise stretches your groins, hamstrings, and spine.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart. Turn your right foot to the right and your left foot slightly inward.

Inhale to lengthen your spine, and extend your arms out to the sides. Then exhale to hinge forward from your hips, rotate your torso to the right while sweeping your right arm up to the ceiling. Gently turn your head to look up at your right fingertips, keeping your neck comfortable. 

Hold this position, breathing steadily. Inhale to extend your spine, exhale to deepen the twist and relax your shoulders.
name: REVOLVED TRIANGLE POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist to the right.
If you feel it's too hard, put your hand on your leg instead of the floor.
This exercise strengthens and stretches your legs.
This exercise stretches your groins, hamstrings, and spine.

introduce:
Stand with feet hip-width apart. Step your left foot forward, while turning your right foot out about 60 degrees.

Inhale, lift your chest and clasp your hands behind your back or grasp a strap or towel with both hands behind you. Exhale, fold forward to the inside of your left knee, and lift your arms up.

Return and repeat with a steady breathing rhythm.
name: HUMBLE WARRIOR LEFT

tips.text: Keep your front knee in line with your toes.
Don\'t let your front knee go over your toes.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs and core muscles.
This exercise opens your chest, hips, and shoulders.
Exhale when leaning forward, and inhale when going backward.

introduce:
Stand with feet hip-width apart. Step your right foot forward, while turning your left foot out about 60 degrees.

Inhale, lift your chest and clasp your hands behind your back or grasp a strap or towel with both hands behind you. Exhale, fold forward to the inside of your right knee, and lift your arms up.

Return and repeat with a steady breathing rhythm.
name: HUMBLE WARRIOR RIGHT

tips.text: Keep your front knee in line with your toes.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
This exercise strengthens your thighs and core muscles.
This exercise opens your chest, hips, and shoulders.

introduce:
Stand tall with your feet together. Take a big step back with your right leg, toes pointing slightly in. Bend your left knee until your left thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Raise your arms to the sides, palms down.

Inhale, lift your left arm overhead for a big stretch along your side. At the same time, lower your right hand and slide it down your right leg. Exhale, draw your belly in and tuck your tailbone to stabilize your core. Take your gaze to your left hand.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, and exhale to relax your side body.
name: REVERSE WARRIOR LEFT

tips.text: Keep your bent knee in line with your toes.
Don\'t put any weight on your back hand.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Don\'t let your bent knee go over your toes.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Engage your core.
This exercise strengthens your thighs and improves your core strength and balance.
This exercise stretches your hips, groins, obliques, and hamstrings.
This exercise releases tension in your muscles around the ribs.
Inhale to strengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your side body.
